description: This file contains repository classes for database operations in a backend project, specifically for entities such as User, Profile, Friend, Match, MatchPlayer, Turn, InventoryItem, Receipt, and FeatureFlag. It uses SQLAlchemy for ORM interactions and defines methods for CRUD operations and data retrieval.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: A simple container class for paginating sequences of objects.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository class encapsulating database operations related to User entities.

classes.name: ProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling Profile entities associated with users.

classes.name: FriendsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing friend relationships between users.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository for creating and managing Match records.

classes.name: MatchPlayerRepository
classes.description: Repository for managing players in a match.

classes.name: TurnRepository
classes.description: Repository for managing turn logs within matches.

classes.name: InventoryRepository
classes.description: Repository for managing user inventory items.

classes.name: ReceiptRepository
classes.description: Repository for handling receipts and transactions.
